project_type: React Native Expo mobile app + Node.js Express backend monorepo
test_framework: No formal test framework configured in package.json
build_command: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot npm install
verification_instructions: AST validation via TypeScript compiler check (npx tsc --noEmit) not available. Use grep/read to verify syntax correctness.
setup_instructions: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot install dependencies
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot add new packages, cannot access external URLs. Only file modifications allowed. Must use existing packages only.
contribution_requirements: Commit directly to fix/final-stabilization branch. Multiple logical commits preferred.
key_patterns: Screens use SafeAreaView+StyleSheet pattern. Theme from lightColors/darkColors. PostCard uses dark theme. Navigation via @react-navigation. State via Redux Toolkit (useAppDispatch/useAppSelector). API calls via api service with interceptors that attach JWT from SecureStore. Push tokens stored via $addToSet in MongoDB user.pushTokens field.
directory_structure: monorepo with mobile/ (Expo React Native), backend/ (Express), admin/ (Vite React). Mobile screens in mobile/src/screens/{auth,create,community,explore,home,post,onboarding,profile}/. Services in mobile/src/services/. Navigation in mobile/src/navigation/.
